TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS	
(	SELECT 
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE ,TRAN_DATE_BAL,TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,VALUE_DATE_BAL,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,END_EOD_DATE ,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME ,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME ,TS_CNT,EAB_CRNCY_CODE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,eod_date,end_eod_date
FROM (	SELECT
[ACID]
,[EOD_DATE ]
,[BANK_ID]
,[TRAN_DATE_BAL]
,[TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN]
,[VALUE_DATE_BAL]
,[VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN]
,[END_EOD_DATE ]
,[LCHG_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as LCHG_TIME
,[RCRE_USER_ID]
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as RCRE_TIME
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as TS_CNT
,[EAB_CRNCY_CODE]
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest

,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]

,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]

,[FILE_NAME]

,convert(datetime2,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [d360].[STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE]
Where H = 'D' 
) A ), TGT AS	
(	SELECT
	HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(ACID,BANK_ID,EOD_DATE ,TRAN_DATE_BAL,TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,VALUE_DATE_BAL,VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,END_EOD_DATE ,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME ,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME ,TS_CNT,EAB_CRNCY_CODE))
	AS HASHROW,
	ACID
	,BANK_ID,eod_date,end_eod_date
FROM	BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE
WHERE	isLatest = 1
)	
INSERT INTO BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE_DELTA (SRC_HR,TGT_HR,ACID,BANK_ID,eod_date,end_eod_date,isActive,isLatest,RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.ACID,TGT.ACID) AS ACID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID,TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID
	,ISNULL(SRC.eod_date,TGT.eod_date) AS eod_date
	,ISNULL(SRC.end_eod_date,TGT.end_eod_date) AS end_eod_date

	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isActive
	,CASE WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isLatest
	,CASE
	    WHEN TGT.ACID IS NULL AND TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
	ELSE 'UPDATE' END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM	SRC
LEFT JOIN TGT
ON	SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND	SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND	SRC.eod_date = TGT.eod_date

	
WHERE	(
TGT.ACID IS NULL
OR	TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
OR	TGT.eod_date IS NULL
	)
OR	SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW;

UPDATE TGT
SET END_EOD_DATE = CONVERT(VARCHAR,DELTA.END_EOD_DATE,112) --CHANGE 20230908
FROM BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE TGT
JOIN BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND DELTA.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND DELTA.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE
WHERE TGT.END_EOD_DATE = '20991231' AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE';


Update BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE set isActive = 0, isLatest = 0 where  concat(ACID,BANK_ID,eod_date,'') in (select concat(ACID,BANK_ID,CONVERT(VARCHAR,eod_date,112),'')  from BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE_DELTA where record_status = 'DELETE') and isLatest = 1;
Update BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE set isLatest = 0 where  concat(ACID,BANK_ID,eod_date,'') in (select concat(ACID,BANK_ID,CONVERT(VARCHAR,eod_date,112),'')  from BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE_DELTA where record_status = 'UPDATE') and isLatest = 1;

select * from BUSC.DELTA_REF_TBL where delta_status = 'DELTA' and source_code = 'GLD' and TABLENAME = 'GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE'

----UT------
--HISTORICAL TESTING

--RECORD count validation
select 'Source' tables, count(1) cnt from d360.STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE where h = 'd' and left(right(file_name,12),8) >= eod_date
UNION ALL
select 'Target' tables, count(1) cnt from busc.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE 

--islatest validation
select 'Source' tables, count(1) cnt from d360.STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE where h = 'd' and END_EOD_DATE = '20991231' and left(right(file_name,12),8) >= eod_date
UNION ALL
select 'Target' tables, count(1) cnt from busc.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE WHERE ISLATEST = 1

--non-islatest validation
select 'Source' tables, count(1) cnt from d360.STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE where h = 'd' and END_EOD_DATE <> '20991231' and left(right(file_name,12),8) >= eod_date
UNION ALL
select 'Target' tables, count(1) cnt from busc.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE WHERE ISLATEST = 0

--duplicate validation
select count(1) dup_cnt from (
    select ACID,EOD_DATE,BANK_ID from busc.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE GROUP BY ACID,EOD_DATE,BANK_ID HAVING COUNT(1)>1 )A

--SOURCE VS TARGET FIELD VALIDATION
WITH SOURCE_TBL AS(
select * from d360.STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE A where h = 'd' and left(right(file_name,12),8) >= eod_date
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * from busc.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE B WHERE 
    A.ACID = B.ACID
    AND A.EOD_DATE = B.EOD_DATE
    AND A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
    AND A.TRAN_DATE_BAL = B.TRAN_DATE_BAL
    AND A.TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN = B.TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
    AND A.VALUE_DATE_BAL = B.VALUE_DATE_BAL
    AND A.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN = B.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
    AND A.END_EOD_DATE = B.END_EOD_DATE
    AND A.LCHG_TIME = format(B.LCHG_TIME,'yyyyMMddHHmmss') 
    AND A.RCRE_USER_ID = B.RCRE_USER_ID
    AND A.RCRE_TIME =  format(B.RCRE_TIME,'yyyyMMddHHmmss')  
    AND A.TS_CNT = B.TS_CNT
    AND A.EAB_CRNCY_CODE = B.EAB_CRNCY_CODE
    ))
, TARGET_TBL AS(
SELECT * from busc.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE B
WHERE NOT EXISTS (select * from d360.STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE A where h = 'd' and left(right(file_name,12),8) >= eod_date   
    AND A.ACID = B.ACID
    AND A.EOD_DATE = B.EOD_DATE
    AND A.BANK_ID = B.BANK_ID
    AND A.TRAN_DATE_BAL = B.TRAN_DATE_BAL
    AND A.TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN = B.TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN
    AND A.VALUE_DATE_BAL = B.VALUE_DATE_BAL
    AND A.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN = B.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN
    AND A.END_EOD_DATE = B.END_EOD_DATE
    AND A.LCHG_TIME = format(B.LCHG_TIME,'yyyyMMddHHmmss') 
    AND A.RCRE_USER_ID = B.RCRE_USER_ID
    AND A.RCRE_TIME =  format(B.RCRE_TIME,'yyyyMMddHHmmss')  
    AND A.TS_CNT = B.TS_CNT
    AND A.EAB_CRNCY_CODE = B.EAB_CRNCY_CODE
    ))
select * into busc.source_vs_target_gld_eod from (
	SELECT 'Source' tables, count(1) cnt FROM SOURCE_TBL
	UNION ALL
	select 'Target' tables, count(1) cnt from TARGET_TBL
	)a

select * from busc.source_vs_target_gld_eod

SELECT 'Source' tables, count(1) cnt FROM SOURCE_TBL
UNION ALL
select 'Target' tables, count(1) cnt from TARGET_TBL



SELECT format(getdate(),'yyyyMMddHHmmssffff')

SELECT
    STG.[ACID]
    ,STG.[EOD_DATE]
    ,STG.[BANK_ID]
    ,[TRAN_DATE_BAL]
    ,[TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN]
    ,[VALUE_DATE_BAL]
    ,[VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN]
    ,STG.[END_EOD_DATE]
    ,[LCHG_USER_ID]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as LCHG_TIME
    ,[RCRE_USER_ID]
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as RCRE_TIME
    ,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as TS_CNT
    ,[EAB_CRNCY_CODE]
    ,1 as isActive
    ,CASE WHEN STG.[END_EOD_DATE] = 20991231 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  as isLatest
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
    ,[FILE_NAME]
    ,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
FROM [BUSC].[GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE_DELTA] DELTA
LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE] STG 
    ON DELTA.ACID = STG.ACID 
    AND DELTA.BANK_ID = STG.BANK_ID
    AND DELTA.EOD_DATE = STG.EOD_DATE
    AND DELTA.END_EOD_DATE = STG.END_EOD_DATE
Where H = 'D' AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT' AND STG.acid = 'PA128531' ORDER BY 2 DESC
